trap.label: in + década
trap.wrong: On the early 1950s, researchers studied DNA fibres.
trap.right: In the early 1950s, researchers studied DNA fibres.
trap.why: Em português “nos anos 1950” usa em/nos. O aluno muda para on. Em inglês, décadas e anos usam in; on é para dias.

fix.right: Her data contributed to the model.

fix.wrong: The model drawed on her pattern.
fix.right: The model drew on her pattern.

fix.wrong: In 1958 he published a paper in the DNA fibre.
fix.right: In 1958 he published a paper on the DNA fibre.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com in: “The date was early in the 1950s.”
Reescreva com drew on: “She used earlier work.”
Reescreva com cautela: “Many question who deserves credit.” (Historians continue to debate…)
rewrite.answer: Historians continue to debate who deserves credit.
